description: This is a Python test script for the 'litellm' library, focusing on testing Helicone integration, asynchronous completion calls, and metadata handling, using pytest and asyncio.

classes.name: HeliconeLogger
classes.description: A class responsible for handling Helicone-specific logging, especially the removal of non-serializable metadata such as OpenTelemetry span objects.

methods.name: pre_helicone_setup()
methods.description: Sets up logging configuration for Helicone integration tests.

methods.name: test_helicone_logging_async()
methods.description: Asynchronous test to verify Helicone logging with and without success callbacks, ensuring timing differences are within expected bounds.

methods.name: make_async_calls(metadata=None, **completion_kwargs)
methods.description: Creates multiple asynchronous completion tasks, measures total elapsed time for responses.

methods.name: create_async_task(**completion_kwargs)
methods.description: Creates and returns an asyncio task calling litellm.acompletion with specified parameters, including mock response.

methods.name: test_helicone_logging_metadata()
methods.description: Asynchronous test to verify metadata handling, especially proper assignment and inclusion of Helicone-specific headers.

methods.name: test_helicone_removes_otel_span_from_metadata()
methods.description: Test verifying that HeliconeLogger removes problematic OpenTelemetry span objects from metadata to prevent serialization errors.
